Per-hole summary

Source: R/process.R
gc_hole_summary.Rd

Per-hole summary

Usage

gc_hole_summary(ds, method, depth = NULL, fun = mean, analytes = NULL)

Arguments

ds

A gc_data object.

method

Method.

depth

Optional c(top, base) window.

fun

Summary function.

analytes

Optional subset.

Value

One row per hole with x, y, n and one column per analyte.

Examples

gc_hole_summary(gc_example, "SRA", analytes = c("TOC", "Tmax"))
#> # A tibble: 12 × 6
